OSS consensus audit (2026-08-13): APPROVED pattern, already merged as 48a3ba0b8a.

pytest-xdist's own maintained how-to says session fixtures otherwise execute once per worker and prescribes a shared tmp_path_factory.getbasetemp().parent artifact protected by an inter-process lock for resource-intensive data (pytest-dev/pytest-xdist@a9372c1, docs/how-to.rst#L156-L200).

The merged digest-keyed session artifact follows that exact practice, remains session-hermetic, and retains all 178 corpus bodies and assertions. It also reduces total work (one corpus fill rather than one per worker), so it does not violate coercive-paediatric-bug's rejection of extra sharding/-n4 that merely trades wall time for more runner-minutes.
